entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Akhilesh Kumar Saxena - Advocate for the appellant.
Mr. Rahul Solanki - Ga for the respondent/State.
Heard on IA No.16135/2025 , application seeking suspension of sentence on behalf of the appellant- Arjun.

Appellant has filed this appeal against the judgment dated 25.02.2025 passed by the Additional Sessions Judge, Khachrod, District Ujjain (M.P.) in ST No.33/2023 whereby the learned trial Court has convicted the appellant under section 376(1) of the IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 10 years with fine of Rs.10,000/- with further default stipulations for committing penetrative sexual assault with a child (PW-1) aged 16 years 7 months and 2 days.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, Khachrod, District Ujjain
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and falsely been implicated in the case.
The final hearing of this appeal will likely to take long time.
Hence prayed for suspension of sentence and release of the appellant on bail.
Counsel for the State has opposed the application.
The age of the child is proved through birth certificate (Exhibit- P/5).

The act of penetrative sexual assault is proved through DNA report (Exhibit-P/5) which found the presence of "Y" male DNA profile on the underwear, public hair and vaginal slide collected during medical 2 CRA-3311-2025 examination of child (PW-1).
No matter of consent arises and the period of custody is not sufficient to enlarge the appellant on bail.
Hence, this Court is not inclined to suspend the sentence passed against the appellant.
Accordingly, the application (IA No.16135/2025) is rejected.
